# RadiusDeck Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We are committed to providing a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free
community for everyone who participates in RadiusDeck. We value constructive
technical discussion, good-faith collaboration, and consideration for people
with different backgrounds and levels of experience.

## Expected behavior

Participants are expected to:

- communicate respectfully and focus feedback on ideas and code;
- accept constructive feedback and acknowledge mistakes;
- give others reasonable time and context to respond;
- respect privacy and avoid sharing confidential or identifying information;
- help maintain a safe and productive environment for contributors and users.

## Unacceptable behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable:

- harassment, intimidation, discrimination, or personal attacks;
- insulting, demeaning, threatening, or sexualized language or imagery;
- sustained disruption of discussions or deliberate bad-faith participation;
- publishing another person's private information without permission;
- unwanted contact after a request to stop;
- retaliation against someone who reports a concern;
- conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional
  community.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all RadiusDeck project spaces, including issues,
pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other project communication channels.
It also applies when someone officially represents the project in public.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainers at
<radiusmanager@proton.me>. Include relevant links, screenshots, dates, and other
context that can help assess the report. Do not disclose sensitive personal
information beyond what is necessary.

Reports will be reviewed as confidentially and impartially as practical. A
maintainer who is involved in a report must not participate in deciding its
outcome. Security vulnerabilities should instead be reported according to
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove or edit content and may issue a correction, warning,
temporary restriction, or permanent ban based on the severity and pattern of
the behavior. Decisions will consider the safety of the community, available
evidence, and whether the participant accepts responsibility and changes their
conduct.

Maintainers are responsible for applying this Code of Conduct consistently.
